◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. killerTaleLog: [day 47] Norbert: The fire settles. Norbert has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Palesa says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Theo asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 47] Rafael: The fire settles. Rafael has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caroline says quietly "Say that again — slower." Theo says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 48] Norbert: The fire settles. Norbert has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Speedbump — I put it down today." "It doesn't move. It hasn't moved in an hour. Its head is suddenly somewhere else." "It seals itself. The shell clicks shut — nearly invulnerable. Wait it out, or flip it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Palesa mutters "Say that again — slower." Greta breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 48] Rafael: The fire settles. Rafael has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aki says "The fire feels smaller now." Palesa asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 49] Theo: The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Norbert says "Did it look at you? Before?" Caroline says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
